finding.classification: misleading same-unit ambiguity between travel and ending phases
finding.rationale: Called by ftZd_SpecialHi_Coll when ground support is lost. The complete body calls ftCommon_8007D60C and changes to state 354 with transition_flags0, preserving the animation frame and using speed 1. It neither sets invisibility nor installs an accessory callback. The nearby aerial ending-entry routine also enters 354, but starts at frame zero, clears invisibility, installs its accessory callback, and scales saved velocity. Thus this helper continues an already-running ending phase in air rather than continuing invisible travel in state 353. The End qualifier makes that distinction explicit.
finding.uncertainty: The proposed spelling is descriptive rather than a recovered original name.
